changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate task names and normalized dataset names. Removed 'Controllable Text Generation' as it's too generic - kept specific evaluated tasks. Normalized model names by removing redundant 'reward model' specification.
Simplified metric names to base forms as per guidelines. Removed redundant descriptions of how metrics are calculated.
GPT-2-XL is used for perplexity calculation (an automatic metric), not as an LLM judge. This paper does not use LLMs as judges after generation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper relies entirely on automatic metrics for evaluation.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on controlled text generation using RAD (Reward-Augmented Decoding) method. It evaluates on detoxification and sentiment control tasks using automatic metrics only. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge evaluation is performed. The metadata was well-extracted with minor normalization needed.
